entities.summary: Angela Frautschi is a Swiss former ice hockey player. She was a member of the Switzerland women's national ice hockey team. She played in the 2006, 2010 and 2014 Winter Olympics. She also competed for ZSC Lions Zurich in the Leistungsklasse A.
